about: Lutsk: the castle, new districts and Volyn houses

Lutsk has a historic centre around Lutsk Castle, Soviet-era estates and many new residential complexes. Around it lies Volyn with its lakes and forests, where people build houses for living and for holidays.
Being close to the Polish border means many clients live and work in the EU and fit out their Lutsk home from a distance. For them we organise the process so that most decisions are made online.

For apartments in new Lutsk complexes — a family layout with plenty of storage; in the old town — respect for historic details. For houses in Volyn — a warm natural palette and direct access to the garden. Design project from $30 per m² (minimum $2,500); packages are on the [interior design studio](/en/interior-design) page.

We renovate apartments and houses, from rough works to furniture, as well as individual rooms. In Volyn we build aerated-block, brick, timber-frame and log houses; for plots by the lakes, with attention to soils and waterproofing.

Renovation is carried out by our salaried team: from $550 per m² for works and rough materials, with finishing materials, furniture and appliances priced separately per estimate. Scope, schedule and payment plan (50/50, 50/30/20 or in stages, from a 10% advance) are fixed in the contract; team travel is on individual terms. Architectural design from $12 per m², house shell from $600 per m², turnkey with finishing from $1,100 per m² — see [turnkey renovation](/en/turnkey-renovation) and [house construction](/en/house-construction).

Design and approvals run online; we travel for measurements and key stages on the schedule set in the contract, and the terms and costs of travel and team accommodation are individual. Between visits you get photo reports every 1–2 weeks, and an online camera on site 24/7 is available for an extra fee.
